import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "font.size": 11, "text.color": "#263238", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
INK = "#263238" BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" SLATE = "#657786"
u1 = np.array([1, 1j, -1, -1j], dtype=complex) if not ( np.allclose(np.conjugate(u1) * u1, np.ones(4)) and np.isclose(np.vdot(u1, u1), 4) and np.isclose(u1 @ u1, 0) ): raise ValueError("The supplied vector does not reproduce the stated products.")
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 3.8), dpi=100) ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1]) ax.set_xlim(0, 1) ax.set_ylim(0, 1) ax.axis("off")
ax.text( 0.04, 0.94, "Hermitian inner product: conjugation prevents cancellation", fontsize=15, fontweight="semibold", va="center", ) ax.text( 0.04, 0.845, r"$\langle a,b\rangle=\sum_{n=0}^{3}\overline{a_n}\,b_n$", fontsize=14, va="center", color=BLUE, ) ax.text( 0.95, 0.845, r"$u_1\in\mathbb{C}^{4},\qquad u_1^{T}u_1=0$", fontsize=12, ha="right", va="center", color=SLATE, )
ax.text( 0.04, 0.735, "Step 1: Take complex conjugate\nof first vector $u_1$", fontsize=11.5, fontweight="medium", va="center", linespacing=1.4, ) ax.text( 0.49, 0.735, "Step 2: Multiply component-by-component\nand sum", fontsize=11.5, fontweight="medium", va="center", linespacing=1.4, )
row_y = [0.595, 0.520, 0.445, 0.370]
def column_vector(x, entries): half_width = 0.025 top, bottom = 0.637, 0.328 tick = 0.008 ax.plot( [x - half_width + tick, x - half_width, x - half_width, x - half_width + tick], [top, top, bottom, bottom], color=INK, lw=1.1, solid_capstyle="butt", ) ax.plot( [x + half_width - tick, x + half_width, x + half_width, x + half_width - tick], [top, top, bottom, bottom], color=INK, lw=1.1, solid_capstyle="butt", ) for y, entry in zip(row_y, entries): ax.text(x, y, entry, fontsize=15, ha="center", va="center")
ax.text(0.055, 0.4825, r"$u_1=$", fontsize=15, va="center") column_vector(0.15, [r"$1$", r"$i$", r"$-1$", r"$-i$"])
ax.annotate( "", xy=(0.253, 0.4825), xytext=(0.198, 0.4825), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color=SLATE, lw=1.2), ) ax.text(0.275, 0.4825, r"$\overline{u_1}=$", fontsize=15, va="center") column_vector(0.389, [r"$1$", r"$-i$", r"$-1$", r"$+i$"])
equations = [ r"$n=0:\quad \overline{u_{1,0}}\,u_{1,0}=1\cdot1=+1$", r"$n=1:\quad \overline{u_{1,1}}\,u_{1,1}=(-i)\cdot i=-i^2=+1$", r"$n=2:\quad \overline{u_{1,2}}\,u_{1,2}=(-1)\cdot(-1)=+1$", r"$n=3:\quad \overline{u_{1,3}}\,u_{1,3}=(+i)\cdot(-i)=-i^2=+1$", ] for index, (y, equation) in enumerate(zip(row_y, equations)): ax.text( 0.49, y, equation, fontsize=10.8, va="center", color=TEAL if index in (1, 3) else INK, )
ax.plot([0.49, 0.95], [0.311, 0.311], color=SLATE, lw=0.9) ax.text( 0.72, 0.257, r"$\langle u_1,u_1\rangle=1+1+1+1=4>0$", fontsize=13.5, ha="center", va="center", color=BLUE, ) ax.text( 0.225, 0.257, "No zero denominator", fontsize=10.5, ha="center", va="center", color=BLUE, )
ax.text( 0.5, 0.151, r"For any nonzero complex vector $a\in\mathbb{C}^{N}$,", fontsize=11, ha="center", va="center", ) ax.text( 0.5, 0.071, r"$\langle a,a\rangle" r"=\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}\overline{a_n}\,a_n" r"=\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}|a_n|^2>0$", fontsize=13.5, ha="center", va="center", color=BLUE, )
